## Function Process Generation

compile → send → parse → verify per card; a compile fault or stale inputs discard the answer; accepted cards fire the commit hook.

Behaviour: processGeneration(cards, deps, root): a card whose acceptance is null or blank (whitespace only) is never compiled or sent → {status "failed", reason "no acceptance", acceptanceLog "no acceptance"}, handled like a compile fault (its retry context, no row, no record). It compiles every other card with compileCard, keeping each input digest; sends all variants of all cards in ONE sendGeneration(deps.config, requests, deps.transport) call, answers and usage sliced back by request index; then verifies each card in input order. A compile fault → {status "failed", reason "compile: <first fault message>", acceptanceLog the fault messages joined by "\n"}; else captureInputs again and compareCaptures with the compile digest — a change → {status "failed", reason "stale inputs", acceptanceLog "stale inputs: <changed paths, ", "-joined>"}, no acceptance run; else one VariantAnswer per variant (id "<customId>.v<n>"; a null text → {corrupt: the answer's error ?? "no text returned"}, else parseAnswer(text, targets)) and verifyCard with timeoutMs = deps.acceptanceTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS (300000), never deps.config.timeoutMs. Accepted → {status "written", winningVariant the accepted id, acceptanceLog its log, earlierFailures the logs of the variants tried before it, commit and diffstat from deps.commit(customId, targets)}; none → {status "failed", reason "acceptance failed", acceptanceLog the last variant's log, earlierFailures the earlier ones, commit null, diffstat null}. attempts is 1 in one round. Returns {outcomes, usage, requests, retryContexts}: usage of every request sent; requests one Request Usage per request sent, in send order ({customId: the request id, model: the request's ?? deps.config.model, provider, generationId, inputTokens, outputTokens, cost from its Usage, finishReason and error from its Answer, then batchId = the send result's batch.batchId on a row whose customId is in batch.customIds, no key otherwise}); retryContexts one Retry Context per FAILED outcome, keyed by customId, in outcome order, none for a written card. Compile fault or stale → {acceptanceOutput: its acceptanceLog, previousDiff: null}. Rejected → of the variants whose acceptance ran (diff not null), the FURTHEST gives {acceptanceOutput: its log, previousDiff: its diff, "" when it changed nothing}: the greatest stageCount(log), a tie → the later; stageCount(log) (exported) counts the log's lines (split on "\n") that begin with "== ". No variant ran (all corrupt or truncated) → {acceptanceOutput: the last result's log, previousDiff: null}; the outcome's acceptanceLog and earlierFailures as above. Each variant sent gets one Variant Record for deps.onVariant when set (without it nothing changes), after its card is decided (an accepted card's commit hook first), card order then variant order: {request: as sent, text, finishReason, error (its Answer's), verdict, stages, lastStage}; verdict "stale" for every variant of a stale card, else "corrupt" or "truncated" by its parsed answer, else "untried" when Verify Card stopped before it, "accepted" for the winner, "rejected" otherwise. Accepted and rejected: stages = stageCount(its log), lastStage(its log) (exported: the text after "== " of the last stage header, null when none); else 0 and null. A compile fault sends nothing and gets no record.

## Function Run Acceptance

Executes the card's acceptance command from the repo root.

Behaviour: runAcceptance(command, root, {env, timeoutMs}) spawns /bin/sh -c with cwd = root, env = the given env minus every key whose upper-cased name starts with MORPH_PROCESSOR_ or ends in _KEY or _TOKEN (no key reaches a model-written test), with NO_COLOR=1 and CI=1 laid over it (nothing else; the caller's object is not changed), detached in its own process group; stdout and stderr merged in write order. timeoutMs defaults to 300000: on expiry the whole process group is killed, so no child outlives the call, and the result is exit null, timedOut true, the output so far kept with the line "acceptance timed out after <ms> ms" appended. The log is clipped by clipLog: over 4000 chars it keeps the first 1500 and the last 1500 chars and, between them, a marker and every middle line that looks like a diagnosis (FAIL, Error, assert, expected), within 800 chars. A SIGINT or SIGTERM of this process during the call kills the group the same way: listeners added BEFORE the spawn (a signal caught before the child exists kills it once spawned), removed when the child closes or fails to start (none outlives the call; Node's default exit waits meanwhile); the result is exit null, timedOut false, the output so far with the line "acceptance interrupted by <signal name>" appended. Returns Acceptance Result.

## Function Run Deck

Generations in order, the budget at each boundary, retries per card (2) capped per generation, a carried-over retry before its dependants, a fault caught, the Run Report.

Behaviour: runDeck(input, deps) runs input.deck generation by generation in the order of layerGenerations(input.deck). At each generation boundary: deps.now() >= input.budget.deadline → every not-yet-done card of this and later generations becomes {status "budget-exceeded", reason "deadline"}; cardsProcessed >= input.budget.maxCards → reason "maxCards <maxCards>". Otherwise, when a not-yet-done card of the generation has a dependsOn id whose outcome is "failed" with retries left, the retry loop below runs FIRST (same cap, same deadline check), so a dependency written by a carried-over retry unblocks it; then it resolves the runnable cards (resolveRunnable, the statuses so far), records the skipped, runs processGeneration on the runnable, accumulates usage and request rows, keeps each failed card's Retry Context (by original id; a later round's replaces an earlier one), adds the runnable count to cardsProcessed. Retries: 2 per card, in whichever generation it runs; input.budget.maxRetryBatches caps the retry batches of ONE generation (retryBatches starts at 0 at each): while some failed card has been retried fewer than 2 times and retryBatches < maxRetryBatches, a retry batch runs (retryBatches += 1) for all such cards (an earlier generation's included), unless deps.now() >= the deadline, checked before each batch: then each such card becomes its outcome with status "budget-exceeded", reason "deadline", and no batch runs. A batch: buildRetry(original card, retryNumber, the latest Retry Context's acceptanceOutput, its previousDiff) each, processGeneration on them; a written retry updates the card's outcome (status "written", its commit, attempts = retry number + 1), every attempt's log appended to earlierFailures. The Run Report: runId, completedAt = deps.now(), branch = input.branch, processor = deps.config.id, generations = the count, outcomes in deck order, usageTotals {inputTokens, outputTokens summed; cost the sum of reported costs, null when none; requests = the usage row count}, requests = every Request Usage row of the run in send order. Returns {report, outcomes}. deps reach every processGeneration call as given (onVariant sees the retries). It writes and commits nothing. It never rejects: a value thrown inside the run (the commit hook, an answer write) stops it, and so does deps.interrupted (optional) returning a string s, called right before each deadline check (boundary and retry batch), as the thrown Error "interrupted by <s>"; every card with no outcome yet becomes {status "skipped", reason "fault", attempts 0, winningVariant null, acceptanceLog "", earlierFailures [], commit null, diffstat null} (the usage of the call in flight is lost) and the report's last key is fault = the Error's message (String(value) otherwise); no fault, no key.

Find Hazards errors → 2 RefusalError "deck has <n> hazard error(s): " + each "<kind> <cards ","-joined>[ <path>]", "; "-joined; then cards whose acceptance is null or blank → 2 RefusalError "deck has <n> card(s) with no acceptance: <ids in deck order, ","-joined>". 4. start = deps.now() (its only call here); runId = args.runId or mintRunId(start) (UTC "YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS"). 5. Open Run Branch(root, runId, deps.env); a refusal → 2 RefusalError, its error. 6. Run Deck, input {root, runId, branch, deck, budget {maxCards: args.maxCards or the card count, maxRetryBatches, deadline: start + deadlineSeconds × 1000}}, deps {config, transport: {...(deps.transport or realTransport(config.timeoutMs)), saveBatch: (record) => git's saveBatchRecord(root, record)}, commit: makeCommitHook(root, config.model, deps.env), now: deps.now, env: deps.env, interrupted: deps.interrupted, onVariant: line = variantLine(record), keep {...record, line}, log given → log(line)}. 7. Archive Run(root, {runId, deck, report, answers: the kept records}, deps.env). → {code: 3 when report.fault is set (the partial report archived), else runExitCode(report, archive), document: {runId, branch, base, report, archive}}. variantLine(r) (exported) = "morph run: <r.request.customId> <verdict> stage <stages>[ <lastStage>] finish <finishReason, or none> chars <text length, or none>\n". The checkout stays on the run branch.

Callee Emit Document: One JSON document + newline on stdout; --pretty indents by 2.
Behaviour: renderDocument(doc, pretty) = JSON.stringify(doc, null, 2 when pretty) + "\n". errorDocument(code, kind, message) = {error: {code, kind, message}}, keys in that order (main writes one per invocation to stdout; the log goes to stderr).

Callee Classify Error: Exit codes: 0 ok; 1 a card not written; 2 a refusal before spend; 3 a fault under way; 4 a usage error.
Behaviour: classifyThrown(e) → {code: 3, document: errorDocument(3, "RuntimeError", e.message for an Error, else String(e))}. runExitCode(report, archive) → 3 when the archive is not ok; else 1 when any outcome is not "written"; else 0. Kinds: UsageError and NotYetError (4), DeckError and RefusalError (2), RuntimeError (3).
